svg.text: Positions from the front face of the front end rail, and from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line. Weld on a flat table; check diagonals.

svg.text: Side rails: two 30 x 30 x 1.5 box, 1,200 mm, ends capped.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End rails and crossmembers: five 640 mm lengths between the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side rails; crossmember centres at 300, 620 and 950 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nose bars: 28 x 1.5 tube from the front rail's face, 15 mm in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from each side, to the coupler housing's sides, 320 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its front end. Fishmouth the ends to sit on the housing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arch frames: 25 x 1.5 tube; outriggers at 320 and 920 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 117.5 mm out from each side rail; a hoop over each tyre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top 546 mm above the ground; a strut down at 620 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: crossmember bottoms at 300 and 620 mm, 100 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (enclosure, 4); M5 in the rear rail face (lights, 4).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tie-down eyes on the side rails at 150 mm from each end.

svg.text: Dropout plates: see CGM-DWG-104. Paint after welding.
